turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    B -->|Draft prompt| D[PROVIDE]

    subgraph ASSAY[ASSAY — read-only]
        C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
        C1 --> C2[Compress document to floor content]
        C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content and function]
        C3 --> C4[Find operative sentence]
        C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and missing rough edge]
        C5 --> C6[Output finding]
        C6 --> C7[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE[PROVIDE — negotiation side]
        D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
        D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for mode]
        D2 --> D1
        D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check floor nouns]
        D3 --> D4{Floor passes?}
        D4 -->|No| D5[Ask up to three largest gaps]
        D5 --> D3
        D4 -->|Yes| D6[Compress prompt]
        D6 --> D7{Cut removed specification?}
        D7 -->|Yes| D8[Name failure and revert]
        D8 --> D6
        D7 -->|No| D9{Two empty cuts?}
        D9 -->|No| D10{Floor still passes?}
        D10 -->|No| D11[Return last passing version]
        D11 --> D12[Output prompt and cut line]
        D10 -->|Yes| D6
        D9 -->|Yes| D13[State contract is minimal]
        D13 --> D12
        D12 --> E[Ask gate question]
    end

    E --> F{Named human signer freezes?}
    F -->|No| D6
    F -->|Yes| G{Execution tools available?}
    G -->|No| H[Gate stays closed]
    G -->|Yes| I[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    I --> J{Result}
    J -->|Success| K[Done]
    J -->|Floor failure| L[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    L --> D6
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: D2 -> D1, L -> D6
